description: Attention matrices of the trained model on a prompt from the validation text. A[i, j, h, l] is how much character i (the reader) takes from character j ≤ i (the source) in head h of block l; each row sums to 1. probs[:, i] is the model's distribution for the character after character i.
prompt:
GREMIO:
Good morrow, neighbour Baptista.

BAPTISTA:
Good morrow, neighbour Gremio.
